purpose: Independent observations for an audit, not calibration targets or CI acceptance bands.

benchmarks.vehicle: Golf MY2025 1.5 TSI 85 kW, six-speed manual
benchmarks.location: Technical data, 1.5 TSI 85 kW, combined consumption
benchmarks.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic car versus a specific homologated product
benchmarks.conditions: Minimum published mass 1307 kg; WLTP test mass and measured road-load coefficients unavailable. Adjusted run uses 1307 kg as curb mass plus 75 kg driver; this is an assumption, not exact homologation mass. Default model road loads, auxiliaries and fuel blend retained.

benchmarks.vehicle: Golf MY2025 2.0 TDI 85 kW, six-speed manual
benchmarks.location: Technical data, 2.0 TDI 85 kW, combined consumption
benchmarks.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic car versus a specific homologated product
benchmarks.conditions: Minimum published mass 1387 kg; adjusted run assumes this is curb mass and adds 75 kg driver, with 85 kW power. Exact homologation mass, coast-down coefficients, cold-start and vehicle control are not matched.

benchmarks.vehicle: Toyota Corolla MY25 hatchback 1.8 hybrid, 103 kW
benchmarks.location: PDF pages 2 and 4; November 2025 MY25 brochure
benchmarks.comparability: WLTC/WLTP cycle family; generic HEV does not reproduce Toyota hybrid control
benchmarks.conditions: Published curb mass 1345-1410 kg; adjusted run takes midpoint 1377.5 kg plus 75 kg driver, 103 kW system power. Default electric/combustion shares, road loads and efficiency maps retained.

benchmarks.vehicle: Anonymized A2 12 m diesel city bus, 209 kW
benchmarks.location: Gis et al. 2017, DOI 10.19206/CE-2017-323, table 1, printed page 137
benchmarks.comparability: Historical 2017 measurement; approximate SORT2 cycle; 13 m model class versus 12 m bus
benchmarks.conditions: Published curb mass 10600 kg; nominal SORT load 3200 kg has vehicle-dependent corrections not fully specified. Adjusted run assumes 13800 kg total, 209 kW, 20 C, HVAC off. Actual HVAC state unspecified. Shipped trace is 938 m versus nominal 920 m; it is not the measured speed trace.

benchmarks.vehicle: Anonymized A3 12 m battery-electric city bus
benchmarks.location: Gis et al. 2017, DOI 10.19206/CE-2017-323, table 1, printed page 137
benchmarks.comparability: Historical measurement; approximate SORT2 cycle; mass, auxiliaries and battery boundary not fully matched
benchmarks.conditions: Electrical consumption measured onboard with WT1800E, not at AC plug. Compare model TtW/36, not electricity consumption*100. Exact test load and battery configuration unclear. No-HVAC case is a sensitivity assumption, not the documented test state.

benchmarks.vehicle: Volvo FH Aero, Scania 420 R Super, DAF XF430, Green Truck 2025
benchmarks.location: PDF page 8, Green Truck 2025 comparison table and route
benchmarks.comparability: Cross-route context only; VECTO-derived Long haul is not the published road-test route
benchmarks.conditions: 342.8 km route, 31 t test combination mass, 79.79-80.18 km/h; fuel excludes AdBlue. Adjusted model uses payload to match 31000 kg within 1 kg, keeping default power, road load and efficiencies. Model route is about 108 km at about 67 km/h including stored zeros.
